en: The Brahmanas said WE have heard that those two are the devotees Nara and Narayana who have taken their birth in the human world. O ruler of the earth, fight with them.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच किं तद् गुह्यं न चाख्यातं कर्णायेहोष्णरश्मिना। कीदृशे कुण्डले ते च कवचं चैव कीदृशम्॥१ कुतश्च कवचं तस्य कुण्डले चैव सत्तम। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तन्मे ब्रूहि तपोधन॥
en: Janamejaya said : What was that secret which the god of hot rays did not give out to Karna? Of what nature were that coat of mail and those two ear-rings? Orighteous one, where did that armour and those two ear-rings of his spring from? O being whose wealth is devotion, I am curious to learn all this. Therefore relate to me all this.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच कीचको मावधीत् तत्र सुराहारीं गतां तवा सभायां पश्यतो राज्ञो यथैव विजने वने॥
en: Draupadi said As I went to fetch wine for you Kichaka struck me in the court in the very presence of the king as if in the midst of a lonely forest.

sa: न मोक्ष्यसे पलायंस्त्वं राजन् युद्धे मनः कुरु। पृथिवीं भोक्ष्यसे जित्वा हतो वा स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि॥
en: You will not be free by escaping. Therefore make up your mind, O king, for fight. By conquering you will enjoy the earth, and by being slain you will attain to heaven.

sa: रक्षितं वालिना यत् तत् स्फीतं मधुबनं महत्। त्वया च प्लवगश्रेष्ठ तद् भुङ्क्ते पवनात्मजः॥
en: "O chief of the monkeys, the great and extensive orchard, Madhuvana which was (so) carefully preserved by Bali and is well-guarded by you also, is being pillaged by the son of Pavana,

sa: पुत्र उवाच उदके भूरियं धार्या मर्तव्यं प्रवणे मया। यस्य मे भवती नेत्री भविष्यद्धतिदर्शिनी॥
en: The son said I shall rescue my kingdom that is sunk in water or die in the attempt-I, who have for my guide yourself who have a great knowledge of the future.

sa: धर्म्यमर्थ्यं च धर्मात्मा ध्रुवं वक्ता जनार्दनः। तस्मिन् वाच्याः प्रिया वाचो भवता बान्धवैः सह।॥
en: Janardana, inclined to virtue, will surely say what is conducive to morality as well as worldly profit; and he should be spoken to in agreeable words by yourself along with your friends.

sa: विरोचन उवाच न मे सुधन्वना सख्यं प्राणयोर्विपणावहे। प्रह्लाद तत्त्वं पृच्छामि मा प्रश्नमनृतं वदेः॥
en: Virochana said There is no friendship between myself and Sudhanvan. (the Truth is that) we have wagered our lives. O sire, I shall ask you a question; do not answer it untruely.

sa: ततस्ते पाण्डवाः शीघ्रं प्रययुर्धर्मकोविदाः॥ ब्राह्मणैः सहिता राजन् ये च तत्र सहोषिताः। इन्द्रसेनादिभिश्चैव प्रेष्यैरनुगतास्तदा।॥
en: Then the Pandavas learned in Dharma soon went away (from the Dvaitavana). O king, with the Brahmanas and all those that lived with them. They were followed by Indrasena and other servants.

sa: विराट उवाच यदस्ति किंचिन्मम वाजिवाहनं तदस्तु सर्वं त्वदधीनमद्य वै। स्त्वदाश्रयाः सारथयश्च सन्तु मे॥
en: Virata said Let all my horses that belong to me be entrusted to your care from today. Let all my charioteers and those to yoke my horses, be henceforth subordinate to you.

sa: नारद उवाच ऐरावतकुले जात: सुमुखो नाम नागराट्। आर्यकस्य मतः पौत्रो दौहित्रो वामनस्य च॥
en: Narad said Born in the race of Airavata, he is the chief of the Nagas, named Sumukha, the grandson of Aryaka and on his mother's side he is the grandson of Vamana.

sa: युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो शृणु धर्मभृतां वर॥ नातप्ततपसो लोके प्राप्नुवन्ति महासुखम्। सुखदुःखे हि पुरुषः पर्यायेणोपसेवते॥
en: "O mighty armed Yudhishthira, O foremost of all virtuous men, lear; those men who do not perform asceticism never obtain great happiness in this world; men experience happiness and misery by turn.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच क्षिप्रमागम्यतां राजन् पाण्डवं वीक्ष्य पार्थिव। त्वय्यधीनः स्म राजेन्द्र वरदानं स्मरस्व नः॥
en: Duryodhana said O king, O Ruler of the earth, come soon after seeing the son of Pandu. I depend on you. O best among kings, remember the boon you have granted me.

sa: यदि कृत्यं न पश्यामि तवाद्याहं यथा पुरा। श्लाघनीयं यशस्यं च का शान्तिर्हृदयस्य मे॥
en: If I do not now see you following such duties as you observed in days gone by which were laudable and conducive to your renown what peace of mind can I get?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच सर्वं त्वमायतीयुक्तं भाषसे प्राज्ञसम्मतम्। न चोत्सहे सुतं त्यक्तुं यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said All that you say is agreed on by the wise and is calculated to do good to me; but I cannot abandon my son. Victory comes where there is righteousness.

sa: गालव उवाच गरुत्मन् भुजगेन्द्रारे सुपर्ण विनतात्मज। नय मां तार्क्ष्य पूर्वेण यत्र धर्मस्य चक्षुषी॥
en: Galava said O Garuda, O enemy of the chief among serpents, O Suparna, O son of Vinata, 0 Tarkshya, take me to the east, where are pointed the two eyes of Dharma.

sa: वरप्रदानं राज्यं च पुत्रजन्म च भारत। शत्रोश्च मोक्षणं कृच्छ्रात् त्रीणि चैकं च तत्समम्॥
en: These three viz., a follower, one who seeks your protection saying I am your and one who has come to your house should never be forsaken, even in times of grave danger.

sa: महायशास्त्वमिति सदाऽभिपूज्यसे मनीषिभिर्मुदितमना महर्षिभिः। अभिष्टुतः पिबसि च सोममध्वरे वषट् कृतान्यपि च हवींषि भूतये॥
en: You are of renown, you are always adored by the wise and the great contemplative Rishis, you drink the Soma juice and the clarified butter offered with sacred invocation in the sacrifices.

sa: मा वधीः कस्य कासीति किं हिनत्सि सुतानिति। पुत्रनि सुमहत् पापं सम्प्राप्तं ते सुगर्हितम्॥
en: "Do not kill it. Who are you? To whom do you belong? Why do you kill your own sons? Murderess of your sons, you are earning great sins by your improper acts."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स तं द्रोणो मोक्षयामास भारत। सत्कृत्य चैनं प्रीतात्मा राज्या) प्रत्यपादयत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata, having been thus addressed, Drona released him (Drupadas); and cheerfully performing the usual offices of regard, he bestowed upon him the half of the kingdom.

sa: रुरुरुवाच क उपायः कृतो देवै—हि तत्त्वेन खेचर। करिष्येऽहं तथा श्रुत्वा त्रातुमर्हति मां भवान्॥
en: Ruru said: O messenger of heaven, (tell me) what means have been provided beforehand by the deities. Tell me in full, so that I may comply with it. You should save me.

sa: शुक्र उवाच बृहस्पतेः सुतः पुत्रि कचः प्रेतगतिं गतः। विद्यया जीवितोऽप्येवं हन्यते करवाणि किम्॥ मैवं शुचो मा रुद देवयानि न त्वादृशी मर्त्यमनुप्रशोचते। यस्यास्तव ब्रह्म च ब्राह्मणाश्च सेन्द्रा देवा वसवोऽथाश्विनौ च॥ मुपस्थाने संनमन्ति प्रभावात्। अशक्योऽसौ जीवयितुं द्विजातिः संजीवितो बध्यते चैव भूयः॥
en: Shukra said : O daughter, the son of Brihaspati, Kacha has gone to the land of the Dead. Though again and again revived by my knowledge, he is often killed. What shall I do? O Devayani, do not grieve, do not weep. One like you should not grieve for one who is mortal. You are worshipped by Brahma, by Brahmanas, the celestials with (their king) Indra, the Vasus, the Ashvinis, the Asuras and by the whole universe. It is impossible to keep him alive. For every time I revive him he is killed (by the Danavas).

sa: कर्मभिर्बहुरूपैश्च तैस्तैर्मनुसुतस्तदा। जनयामास धर्मात्मा शतं देवसुतोपमान्॥ तेषामवरजस्तात सर्वेषां रघुनन्दन। मूढश्चाकृतविद्यश्च न शुश्रूषति पूर्वजान्॥
en: Thereupon performing many pious rites Manu's son engendered a hundred sons. O descendant of Raghu, the youngest of all those sons became stupid and ignorant and did not respect his elder brothers.

sa: भवतां च यथा जन्म तदप्यागमितं मया। सकुण्डलं सकवचं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम्। कथमादित्यसदृशं मृगी व्याघ्नं जनिष्यति॥
en: I know also about your own birth. Can a deer give birth to this tiger, as effulgent as the sun, born with a natural armour and ear-rings and possessing all auspicious mark?

sa: भवति चात्र श्लोकः इदं हि वेदैः समितं पवित्रमपि चोत्तमम्। धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं श्रोतव्यं नियतात्मभिः॥
en: Here occurs a sloka. “This Bharata is equal to the Vedas. It is holy and good. It gives wealth, fame and life. Therefore, it should be heard by men with great attention.”

sa: यदाश्रौषं यक्षरूपेण धर्म समागतं धर्मराजेन सूत। प्रश्नान्कांश्चिद्विब्रुवाणं च सम्यक्। तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: on I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Dharma had come in the guise of a Yaksha and asked some questions of Yudhishthira, who answered them well.

sa: यथा तस्य तथा नस्त्वं निर्विशेषा वयं त्वयि। भवतश्च यथा तस्य पालयास्मान् यथा कविः॥
en: As you are his, so you ours. Do not make any difference between him and us. We are as much yours as his. Protects us as that learned man (Vidura) protects us.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच क्षुतस्त्वत्तो मया ब्रह्मन् पूर्वेषां सम्भवो महान्। उदाराश्चापि वंशेऽस्मिन् राजानो मे परिश्रुताः॥
en: Janamejaya said : O Brahmana, I have heard from you the great history of my ancestors. I have also heard from you about the great kings that were born in my dynasty.

sa: व्यास उवाच अस्मिन् धर्मे विप्रलब्धे लोकवेदविरोधके। यस्य यस्य मतं यद् यच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि तस्य तत्॥
en: Vyasa said : O king, this, being opposed to both usage and the Vedas, has become obsolete. I desire to hear what is the opinion of each of you in this matter.

sa: यौ तौ मया ते कथितौ पूर्वमेव महाबलौ। त्रयस्त्रयाणां लोकानां पर्याप्ता इति मे मतिः॥
en: I have already told you before every thing about these two greatly powerful heroes. My opinion is that these two heroes and Jarasandha were more than a match for the three worlds.

sa: न सीतायाः परां भार्यां ववे स रघुनन्दनः। यज्ञे यज्ञे च पल्यर्थं जानकी काञ्चनीभवत्॥
en: And from the time of Sita's entering into Pātāla he did not take any other spouse. And having made a golden image of Sītā he engage in the performance of various sacrifices.

sa: इदं च तत्राद्भुतरूपमुत्तम जगाद देवर्षिरतीतमानुषम्। महानुभावा किल सा सुमध्यमा बभूव कन्यैव गते गतेऽहनि॥
en: The celestial Rishi told me of a very wonderful incident, namely that the highsouled lady of slender waist (Draupadi) regained her virginity day after day (i.e., every day after her previous marriage).

sa: कारणं ब्रूहि गन्धर्व किं तद् येन स्म धर्षिताः। यान्तो वेदविदः सर्वे सन्तो रात्रावरिंदमाः॥
en: O Gandharva, we are all chastisers of foes; we are all learned in the Vedas and we are all) virtuous. Tell us why we were censured by you when travelling at night.

sa: किमिदं साहसं भीरु कृतवत्यसि भाविनि। कश्चायं सुभगे देशः का च त्वं कस्य वाऽत्मजा॥
en: Arjuna said : O handsome maiden, O timid girl, what a bold act have performed! O blessed damsel, where is this beautiful region situated? Who are you and whose daughter are you?

sa: यदाश्रौषं न विदुर्मामकास्तान् प्रच्छन्नरूपान्वसतः पाण्डवेयान्। विराटराष्ट्रे सह कृष्णया च तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that my sons had failed to discover the Pandavas when they lived in disguise with Draupadi in the kingdom of Virata.

sa: यदाश्रौषं कलहद्यूतमूलं मायाबलं सौबलं पाण्डवेन। हतं संग्रामे सहदेवेन पापं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Saubala, the man of magic power and the root of the gaming and the feud, had been killed by Sahadeva.

sa: सा चिन्तये सदा पुत्र ब्राह्मणस्यास्य किं न्वहम्। प्रियं कुर्यामिति गृहे यत् कुर्युरुषिताः सुखम्॥
en: O son, I always think what might be good for the Brahmana and what good I can do to him, as men who live in others, house (ought to) try to do.

sa: तमुवाच च कौन्तेयः पश्याम्येनं वनस्पतिम्। भवन्तं च तथा भ्रातृन् भासं चेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: That son of Kunti (Yudhisthira) said, “ I see lord of the forest (tree), your self, my brothers and the bird." He said this again being asked (by Drona) again and again.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते वनेन वनं गत्वा जन्तो मृगगणान् बहून्। अपक्रम्य ययू राजंस्त्वरमाणा महारथाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, hose mighty car-warriors the heroes (the Pandavas), went from forest of forest, killing many beasts. In course of their travel and they crossed many forests (came to).

sa: ततो विपाप्मा द्रविडेषु राजन् समुद्रमासाद्य च लोकपुण्यम्। अगस्त्यतीर्थं च महापवित्रं नारीतीर्थान्यथ वीरो ददर्श॥
en: O king, then being cleansed. of his sins, he came to the sea in the Dravida. The hero then saw the greatly holy and sacred Agastya Tirtha and also the Nari Tirtha.

sa: स तत्र सिद्धानभिवाद्य सर्वान् प्रत्यर्चितो राजवद् देववच्च। विवेश सर्वैः सहितो द्विजावयैः कृताञ्जलिर्धर्मभृतां वरिष्ठः॥
en: Then saluting all the Siddhas and being adored by them in return like a king or a god, that foremost of the pious, accompanied by all the leading twice-born, entered (the forest).

sa: वद सत्यं वनस्यास्य पर्वतस्याथवा दिशः। देवता त्वं हि कल्याणि त्वां वयं शरणं गताः॥
en: O blessed one! speak the truth, as to whether you are the deity presiding over this forest or the goddess of this mountain or of the cardinal quarters? We seek your shelter.

sa: दुर्जेयः शाश्वतो धर्मः शूद्रयोनौ हि वर्तते। न त्वां शूद्रमहं मन्ये भवितव्यं हि कारणम्॥
en: As it is very difficult for a Shudra to learn the mysteries of eternal religion. I do not consider you to be a Shudra. There must be some reason for all this.

sa: यो हि प्रश्न न विब्रूयाद धर्मदर्शी सभां गतः। अनृते या फलावाप्तिस्तस्याः सोऽधू समश्नुते॥
en: The man who knows the rules of morality and sits in an assembly, incurs half the demerit that attaches to a lie, if he does not answer a question put to him.

sa: विदुर उवाच महाराज विजानीहि यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि भारत। मुमूर्षोरौषधमिव न रोचेतापि ते श्रुतम्॥
en: Vidura Said O great, O descendant of Bharata, attend to what I say, although it may not be agreeable to you like medicine to one who is at the point of death.

sa: स तद् वाक्यमुपलभ्य व्यथितेन्द्रियमनाः प्रोवाच प्रसीद राजन्नहमायुर्नाम मण्डूकराजो मम सा दुहिता सुशोभना नाम। तस्या हि दौःशील्यमेतद् बवहस्त्या राजानो विप्रलब्धाः पूर्वा इति॥ तमब्रवीद् राजा तया समर्थी सा मे दीयतामिति।
en: Having heard his words, he (the frog king) thus spoke with his senses and mind much pained, "O king, be kind. I am the king of the frogs, named Ayu. She was my daughter, named Sushobhana. This is but an instance of her bad character. She had deceived many other kings before. Then the king said, “I desire to have her. Let her be given to me by you."

sa: ब्रूहि सर्वानवद्याङ्गि का त्वं किं च चिकीर्षसि। दृष्ट्वैव ते परं रूपं द्युतिं च परमामिह॥ विस्मयो नः समुत्पन्न: समाश्वसिहि मा शुचः। अस्यारण्यस्य देवी त्वमुताहोऽस्य महीभृतः॥
en: O you of faultless limbs! tell us who are you and what do you scek? We are amazed seeing your great beauty and your extreme splendour. Be consoled and do not grieve. O faultless one! O blessed one! say whether you are the presiding deity of this forest or of this mountain or of this rivulet? Speak the truth!”

sa: हा वीर नल नामाहं नष्टा किल तवानघा अस्यामटव्यां घोरायां किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे॥
en: Alas O hero! O Nala! verily am I done for in this wood, although I belong to you. O sinless one! wherefore do you not answer me lost in this dreary forest?

sa: सुसंयताश्चापि जटा विषक्ता द्वैधीकृता नातिसमा ललाटे। कर्णौ च चित्रैरिव चक्रवाकैः समावृतौ तस्य सुरूपवद्भिः॥
en: Her massy hair is neatly tied unto they stuck to the head and forehead evenly divided in two. His two eyes seemed to be covered by wonderful and exceedingly beautiful Chakravaka (birds).

sa: अकृतास्त्रेण पृथिवी जिता बीभत्सुना पुरा। किं पुनः स कृतास्त्रोऽद्य न हन्याद् वो महारथः॥
en: While unaccomplished in arms, Bibhatsu (Arjuna) conquered the whole earth. He is now a great car-warrior and highly accomplished in arms, why will he not be able (now) to kill you all?

sa: सहदेव उवाच अक्षान् यान् मन्यसे मूढ गान्धाराणां यशोहर। नैतेऽक्षा निशिता बाणास्त्वयैते समरे वृताः॥
en: Sahadeva said O fool, O destroyer of the fame of the Gandhara kings, what you are thinking as dice is not dice. They are sharp-pointed arrows which you have invited in battle.

sa: त्वयाऽऽक्षिप्ता महाबाहो दीप्यमानेव दृश्यते। तथैव तव राजेन्द्र राजानः परवीरहन्॥ शासनेऽधिष्ठिताः सर्वे किं कुर्म इति वादिनः। तवेयं पृथिवी राजन् निखिला सागराम्बरा॥ सपर्वतवना देवी सग्रामनगराकरा। नानावनोद्देशवती पर्वतैरुपशोभिता।॥ वन्द्यमानो द्विजै राजन् पूज्यमानश्च राजभिः। पौरुषाद् दिवि देवेषु भ्राजसे रश्मिवानिव॥
en: O mighty armed hero, O chastiser of foes, all the kings of the world are now under your subjection. They now await your commands as they used to do before those of Yudhishthira. O king, the goddess earth bounded with the seas with her mountains and forests towns and cities and mines, with her woodlands and hills is now yours. Adored by the Brahmanas and worshipped by the kings, O monarch, you (now) blaze forth in your prowess like the sun among the celestials in heaven.

sa: हतेन राज्येन तथा धनेन रत्नैश्च मुख्यैर्न तथा बभूव। यथा त्रपाकोपसमीरितेन कृष्णाकटाक्षेण बभूव दुःखम्॥
en: They were not so much pained at the robbing of their kingdom, their wealth, and their costly gems, as they were by that glance of Krishna (Draupadi), full of modesty and anger.

sa: आसीनश्च शयानश्च यः पश्यति नरः पितृन्। उन्माद्यति स तु क्षिप्रं स ज्ञेयस्तु पितृग्रहः॥
en: When a man sees his deceased ancestors while he is comfortably seated or while he is lying in his bed, he turns mad. The spirit who causes this is called ancestral spirit.

sa: श्वदृतौ क्षीरमासक्तं ब्रह्म वा वृषले यथा। सत्यं स्तेने बलं नार्यो राज्यं दुर्योधने तथा॥
en: "As milk in a bag made of a boar's hide, as the Vedas in a Shudra, as truth in a robber and as strength in a woman, so is sovereignty in Duryodhana.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच दायं तु विविधं तस्मै शृणु मे गदतोऽनघ। यज्ञार्थं राजभिर्दत्तं महान्तं धनसंचयम्॥
en: Duryodhana said O sinless one, listen to me as I describe that large mass of wealth, consisting of various kinds of tributes presented to him (Yudhishthira) by the kings of the earth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं स बहुशः सर्वानुक्तवांस्तान् सभासदः। न च ते पृथिवीपालास्तमूचुः साध्वसाधु वा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus did he (Vikarna) repeatedly appeal to those that were present in the assembly to answer Draupadi's question. But the kings present did not say a word good or ill.

sa: घण्णां तु प्रवरं तस्य शीर्षाणामिह शब्द्यते। शक्तिं येनासृजद् दिव्यां भद्रशाख इति स्म ह॥ इत्येतद् विविधाकारं वृत्तं शुक्लस्य पञ्चमीम्। तत्र यद्धं महाघोरं वृत्तं षष्ठ्यां जनाधिप॥
en: That head by which Bhadrashakha created the celestial energy and prowess is considered to be the best (of all his heads). O lord of men, these holy and wonderful events all took place on the fifth day of the bright fortninght of the lunar month and on the sixth day a very fearful battle was fought at that place.

sa: न चेद् गुह्यं महाबाहो श्रोतव्यं चेद् भवेन्मम्। शिष्यवत् त्वां तु पृच्छामि उपपन्नोऽस्मि तेऽनघ॥
en: O mighty armed hero (tell me) if it is not a secret and if I deserve to hear it. O sinless one, I seek your refuge and ask you as a disciple.

sa: कुमार्य ऊचुः भवेम सर्वलोकस्य मातरो वयमुत्तमाः॥ प्रसादात् तव पूज्याश्च प्रियमेतत् कुरुष्व नः। सोऽब्रवीद् बाढमित्येवं भविष्यध्वं पृथग्विधाः॥ शिवाश्चैवाशिवाश्चैव पुनः पुनरुदारधीः। ततः संकल्प्य पुत्रत्वे स्कन्दं मातृगणोऽगमत्॥
en: The girls said, “Do us this favour, by your blessing may we become the good and the respected mothers of all the worlds." He replied, “Let it be so." And that high-souled one again and again said, “You shall be devided into Shivas and Ashivas (good and evil spirits). Then after having established Skanda's sonship, the mothers went away.

sa: तथा भीष्मेण द्रोणेन कर्णेन च कृपेण च। समियाय यथान्यायं द्रौणिना च विभुः सह॥
en: Bhishma, Drona, Karna and Kripa, the lord (Yudhishthira) also met the son of Drona (Ashvathama) he duly saluted and embraced all of them and was saluted and embraced by them in return.

sa: पापं कुर्वन् पापवृत्तः पापस्यान्तं न गच्छति। तस्मात् पुण्यं यतेत् कर्तुं वर्जयीत च पापकम्॥
en: The sinful man who is addicted to vices never comes to the end of his course of inequities. Therefore we must do what is virtuous and forbear from doing what is sinful.

sa: पतमानां सरिच्छेष्ठांधारयिष्ये त्रिविष्टपात्। एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचो राजा शर्वेण समुदाहृतम्॥ प्रयतः प्रणतो भूत्वा गङ्गां समनुचिन्तयत्। ततः पुण्यजला रम्या राज्ञा समनुचिन्तिता॥ ईशानं च स्थितं दृष्ट्वा गगनात् सहसा च्युता। तां प्रच्युतामथो दृष्ट्वा देवाः सार्धं महर्षिभिः॥ गन्धर्वोरगयक्षाश्च समाजग्मुर्दिदृक्षवः। ततः पपात गगनाद् गङ्गा हिमवतः सुता॥
en: I shall sustain (on my head) that foremost of rivers when falling from the heaven." Having heard these words uttered by Shiva, the king, began to meditate on Ganga with his head down the subdued soul. Thereupon the charming Ganga of holy water, being thus meditated upon by the king and seeing Ishana (Shiva) standing there, suddenly began to fall (from heaven). Having seen her thus falling, the celestials with the great Rishis. Also the Gandharvas, the Nagas and the Yakshas all came there as spectators. Then the daughter of Himalayas Ganga fell from the sky.

sa: गच्छ मूर्धा प्रपन्नोऽस्मि पादौ ते वरवर्णिनि। त्वं हि मातृवत् पूज्या रक्ष्योऽहं पुत्रवत् त्वया॥
en: O beautiful complexioned one, go away, I bow my head to you, I prostrate myself at your feet. You are worthy of my worship as my mother. Protect me as your son.

sa: ततो दधीचः परमप्रतीतः सुरोत्तमांस्तानिदमभ्युवाच। करोमि यद् वो हितमद्य देवाः स्वं चापि देहं स्वयमुत्सृजामि॥
en: Thereupon Dadhichi, becoming very much pleased and addressing those foremost of celestials said, “O celestials, I shall do today what is to your benefit. I shall even give up my body myself."

sa: संवर्त उवाच अयमिन्द्रो हरिभिरायाति राजन् देवैः सर्वैस्त्वरितैः स्तूयमानः। मन्त्राहूतो यज्ञमिमं मयाद्य पश्यस्वैनं मन्त्रविसस्तकायम्॥
en: I have, by the power of my incantations, attracted Indra bodily to this sacrifice. See, O king, Indra coming with his horses, and adored by the other celestials hastening to this sacrifice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्तः स तु तं प्राह व्यासो वेदविदां वरः। युधिष्ठिरं महातेजाः पुनरेव महाकविः॥ एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा वदसि भारत। राजाऽयं वृद्धतां प्राप्तः प्रमाणे परमे स्थितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus addressed by the king, Vyasa, that foremost of all persons knowing the Vedas, that foremost of poets gifted with great energy, once more said to Yudhishthira these words, 'It is so, O mighty-armed one! It is as you say, O Bharata! This king has reached old age, He is now in the last stage of life.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विलप्य विरता भर्तुः पादौ प्रगृह्य सा। उपविष्टाभवद् दीना सोच्छ्वासं पुत्रमीक्षती॥
en: Vaishampayana said Ceasing to lament, the cheerless queen, taking upon her lap the feet of her husband, sat there, sighing heavily and desiring also for the restoration of her son to life.

sa: पित्र्यं वा भजते शीलं मातृजं वा तथोभयम्। न कथंचन संकीर्णः प्रकृतिं स्वां नियच्छति॥
en: A son inherits the disposition of either the father or the mother. Sometimes he inherits the dispositions of both. A person of impure birth can never succeed in concealing his true nature.

sa: गङ्गा उवाच जातरूपः स गर्भो वै तेजसा त्वमिवानघ। सुवर्णो विमलो दीप्तः पर्वतं चावभासयत्॥
en: Ganga said The foetus is of goldhue. In energy it is like you, O sinless one! Of an excellent colour, perfectly stainless, and burning with splendour, it has lighted the entire mountain.

sa: इमं स्तवं भगवतो विष्णोळसेन कीर्तितम्। पठेद् य इच्छेत् पुरुष: श्रेयः प्राप्तुं सुखानि च।।१४१
en: This hymn in praise of the illustrious Vishnu, composed by Vyasa, should be recited by that person who desires to acquire happiness and that which is of the highest benefit (viz., Emancipation).

sa: हिरण्यरेता नोष्ण स्यात् परिवर्तेत मेदिनी। भासं तु न रविः कुर्यान्न तु सत्यं चलेन्मयि॥
en: Even if the god of fire cease to cause heat and warmth, or the earth change its nature, or the sun cease to give light, I shall never deviate from the truth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथोत्थाय जलात् तस्मात् सर्वं ते समुपागमन्। नापश्यंश्चापि ते तानि बिसानि पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Coming up, they went to that side of the bank where they had placed the lotusstalks. Reaching that place, those foremost of men found that the stalks were nowhere to be seen.

sa: तृष्णा मे बाधतेऽत्युग्रा क्षुधा निर्दहतीव माम्। मुञ्चैनं न हि शक्ष्यामि राजन् मन्दयितुं क्षुधाम्॥
en: I have been possessed by a terrible thirst and hunger is knawing my bowels, Release the bird and cast him off. I am unable to bear the pains of hunger any longer.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच आलोकदानं नामैतत् कीदृशं भरतर्षभ। कथमेतत् समुत्पन्नं फलं वा तद् ब्रवीहि मे।॥
en: Yudhishthira said Of what kind is the gift of light, О chief of Bharata's race? How did this gift originate? What are the merits of it? Do you tell me all this.

sa: यत् तद् भगवता प्रोक्तं पुरा केशव सौहृदात्। तत् सर्वं पुरुषव्याघ्र नष्टं मे भ्रष्टचेतसः॥
en: What your holy self said to me at that time, O Keshava, through love, has all been forgotten by me, O chief of men, on account of the fickleness of my mind.

sa: मेरो: समुद्रस्य च सर्वयत्नैः संख्योपलानामुदकस्य वापि। शक्यं वक्तुं नेह गङ्गाजलानां गुणाख्यानं परिमातुं तथैव॥
en: One may, displaying his best powers, count the stones of the mountain Meru or measure the waters of the ocean. But one cannot count all the merits of the waters of Ganga.

sa: द्रव्याण्याददते चैव दुःखं यान्ति पतन्ति च। ततोऽन्यत् कर्म यत्किचिन्न पुण्यं न च पातकम्॥२६
en: There are some men who appropriate others properties. These certainly fall into Hell and meet with misery. All other acts that men do are indifferent, being considered as neither righteous nor sinful.

sa: मरुत्त उवाच नारदेन भवान् मह्यमाख्यातो ह्यटता पथि। गुरुपुत्रौ ममेति त्वं ततो मे प्रीतिरुत्तमा॥
en: Marutta said I have been told by Narada, wandering on his way, that you are the son of our familypriest, and this (information) has bent my mind (towards you), with great satisfaction.

sa: कदा द्रक्ष्यामि नां देवीं यदि जीवति सा पृथा। जीवन्त्या ह्यद्य मे प्रीतिर्भविष्यति जनाधिप॥
en: Alas, when shall I see queen Pritha, if, indeed, she is alive! I shall consider my life as not passed in vain if I succeed in seeing her once more, O king.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यो महाराज दशाष्टौ च समागताः॥ अष्टादशाहेन हताः कुरुभिर्योधपुगवैः। भीष्मद्रोणकृपाद्यैश्च कर्णेन च महात्मना॥ युयुधानेन वीरेण धृष्टद्युम्नेन चैव ह। चतुर्भिः पाण्डुपुत्रैश्च भीमार्जुनयमैस्तथा॥ न च क्षयोऽयं नृपते ऋते दैवबलादभूत्।
en: Eighteen Akshauhinis of soldiers, O monarch, were collected. In eighteen days that army was destroyed by the foremost of Kuru warriors, viz., Bhishma and Drona and others, and the great Karna, and the heroic Yuyudhana and Dhritadyumna, and by the four sons of Pandu, that is, Bhima and Arjuna and the twins. This destruction, O kiing, could not happen without the influence of Destiny.

sa: प्रक्षिप्तः सम्मतः क्षुद्रः पुत्रो मे पुरुषाधमः। न युद्धं रोचयेद् भीष्मो न चाचार्यः कथंचन॥
en: This narrow minded prince (Duryodhana) with all his prosperity has been hurled to the nether regions by a number of wretches. Bhishma did not like this war, nor did the preceptor (Drona).

sa: तमेकं कुञ्जरं क्रुद्धाः समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैर्व्यरोचत महाद्विपः॥ संजातरुधिरोत्पीडो धातुचित्र इवाद्रिराट्। दशार्णाधिपतिश्चापि गजं भूमिधरोपमम्॥ समास्थितोऽभिदुद्राव भगदत्तस्य वारणम्। तमापतन्तं समरे गजं गजपति: स च॥
en: Surrounded that single elephant on all sides. That huge elephant pierced with many shafts and shedding blood profusely, appeared beautiful like the king of mountains decked with red chalk solution. The ruler of the Dasharnas, mounted on an elephant prodigious like a mountain, dashed against the elephant of Bhagadatta. Beholding that elephant rush towards himself that foremost of elephants,

sa: सर्वा रथगताः कन्या रथा: सर्वे चतुर्युजः। रथे रथे शतं नागाः सर्वे वै हेममालिनः॥
en: All those damsels were mounted on chariots; and to all the chariots were harnessed four steeds; and again every chariot was attended with a hundred elephants all decked with chains of gold.

sa: आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा न त्यजन्ति स्म संयुगम्। यथोत्साहं तु समरे निजघ्नुस्तावका रणे॥
en: Did not desert the fight having formed a laudable determination (to fight to the last); and those foremost of car-warriors began to slay (the hostile troop) to the best o their energies.

sa: शान्ते भीष्मे तथा द्रोणे सूतपुत्रे च पातिते। निराशो जीविते राज्ये पुत्रेषु च भविष्यसि॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, and Drona and the son of a Suta being felled down, you will despair of your life, of the kingdom and of the life of your sons.

sa: शयनस्यानुरूपं वै शीघ्रं वीर प्रयच्छ मे। त्वं हि पार्थ समर्थो वै श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥४।
en: That will be suitable to my bed, and O hero, give that to me soon. You only, O Partha, are equal to the task, you are the foremost of all the bowmen;

sa: न च तेऽन्या गतिाय्या भवेद् भद्रे यथा पिता। पतिर्वापि गतिर्नार्याः पिता वा वरवर्णिनि॥
en: There is no other proper refuge for you, O gentle lady, save your father; for either the father or the husband is the refuge of a woman, O you or fair complexion.

sa: नारद उवाच भगीरथं च राजानं मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम। येन भागीरथी गङ्गा चयनैः काञ्चनैश्चिता॥
en: Narada said () Srinjaya, we also heard that king Bhagiratha, fell a prey to death, Bhagiratha who caused the banks of Ganga-called Bhagirathi after him-to be covered with flights of golden steps.

sa: यः शृणोति च काकुत्स्थ सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात्। सर्वे पापाः प्रणश्यन्ति आयुः कीर्तिश्च वर्धते ॥
en: O Kākutstha, he that listen to the sacred history of Ganga's descent, conferring length of days, attain all his desires, and all his sins are destroyed, and his life and fame increase.

sa: नन्वहं तेऽप्रियः पुत्र मातरं पश्य धार्मिकीम्। किं च नालिङ्गसे पुत्र सुकुमार वचो वद॥
en: If, my son, you do not feel kindly to me, do you look up to your virtuous mother. And why, O son, do you not embrace me? Do you speak tender words.

sa: तदा भृशात् बहु चैव भाषिणी विलापपूर्वं करुणं च भामिनीम्। जहार पापस्तरुणी विचेष्टती नृपात्मजामागतगात्रदे'थुः॥
en: And the wicked (Rävaņa) with a shaking frame carried away the daughter of the king extremely distressed, speaking much, and speaking piteously, uttering lamentations, and putting forth endeavours (to free herself.) saw

sa: एषा हि प्रकृतिः स्त्रीणामा सृष्टे रघुनन्दन । समस्थमनुरज्यन्ते विषमस्थं त्य नन्ति च ॥
en: O son of Raghu, this has been the nature of the fair sex from the commencement of creation, that they gladden him that is well off, and forsake a person in adversity.

sa: तेषामेवं विषण्णानां पीडितानामतीव च। बाष्पविप्लुतनेत्राणां सशोकानां मुमूर्षया॥ अभिगम्य निवृत्तानां रामं नगरवासिनाम्। उद्गतानीव सत्त्वानि बभूवुरमनस्विनाम्॥ स्वं स्वं निलयमागम्य पुत्रदारैः समावृताः। अश्रूणि मुमुचुः सर्वे बाष्पेण पिहिताननाः॥
en: Then with depressed spirits, and exceedingly afflicted, with tears flooding their eyes, smitten with mortal grief, the inhabitants of the city went back from Rāma to the city. And with their lives appearing as ready to go out, those unsteady ones came to their respective homes, and surrounded by their wives and sons, washed their faces with copious tears.

sa: यस्या मदभिषेकार्थे मानसं परितप्यते। माता नः सा यथा न स्यात् सविशङ्का तथा कुरु॥
en: Do you act therefore in such a way as will remove the apprehension from the mind of our mother (Kaikeyi), who is troubled at heart so greatly on hearing of my installation.

sa: उत्सहे य हि विस्तीर्णमालिखन्तमिवाम्बरम्। मेहं गिरिमसङ्गेन परिगन्तुं सहस्रशः॥ बाहुवेगप्रणुन्नेन सागरेणाहमुत्सहे। समाप्लावयितुं लोकं सपर्वतनदीह्रदम्॥
en: I without once stopping, circumambulate the extensive heaven-cleaving mountain, Meru, for a thousand tin And, dashing the ocean with my arms, I can del the world with its mountains, rivers and lakes.

sa: अथात्मपरिधानार्थं सीता कौशेयवासिनी। सम्प्रेक्ष्य चीरं संत्रस्ता पृषती वागुरामिव ॥ सा व्यपत्रपमाणेव प्रगृह्य च सुदुर्मनाः। कैकेय्याः कुशचीरे ते जानकी शुभलक्षणा॥ अश्रुसम्पूर्णनेत्रा च धर्मज्ञा धर्मदर्शिनी। गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमं भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥ कथं नु चीरं बध्नन्ति मुनयो वनवासिनः। इति ह्यकुशला सीता सा मुमोह मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: Then Sītā clad in silk apparel, eyeing the ascetic covering meant for her, became agitated, like a doe at sight of a noose. And afflicted with shame, that one graced with auspicious marks, Jänakī, sorrowfully took from Kaikeyī the Kuća and bark; and with tears flooding her eyes, that one cognizant of virtue and having her gaze ever fixed upon it, thus addressed her lord resembling the king of the Gandharvas, “How do the ascetics dwelling in the woods put on their dress? Saying this, Sītā, ill at ease became embarrassed.

sa: ततो वसिष्ठः सुप्रीतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥ उपयाता नरव्याघ्र राजानस्तव शासनात्। मयापि सत्कृताः सर्वे यथार्ह राजसत्तम॥
en: Thereupon Vasiştha well-pleased said to the king, O tiger among men, obeying your mandate the kings have come here; and I too according to merit, have received those excellent kings with respect.

sa: भ्राता कथं नाम महागुणस्य भ्रातुर्वधं राम विरोचयेत। राज्यस्य दुःखस्य च वीर सारं विचिन्तयन्कामपुरस्कृतोऽपि॥
en: How can a brother, O Rāma, however avaricious he might be, relish the destruction of his qualified brother, comparing the happiness of a kingdom, with the grief (consequent upon his brother's demise)?

sa: दत्वा वरं चापि तपोधतानानां धर्मे धृतात्मा सह लक्ष्मणेन। तपोधनैश्चापि सहार्यदत्त : सुतीक्ष्णमेवाभिजगाम वीरः॥
en: Having been conferred a boon by the ascetics, that hero entered upon a noble undertaking, and accompanied by the ascetics, in company with Laksmana directed his course to the hermitage of) Sutiksna.

sa: अग्नि संशमयत्वार्यः सीता च भजतां गुहाम्। सज्जं कुरुष्व चापं च शरांश्च कवचं तथा॥
en: O noble one, do you put out the fire; and let Sītā go into the cave. And do you string your bow and make ready the arrows and don on your mail.

sa: ततोऽपरेधुस्तं देशमाजगाम स वीर्यवान्। विभाण्डकसुतः श्रीमान् मनसाचिन्तयन्मुहुः॥ मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्याः स्वलंकृताः।
en: And the next day his mind momentarily running upon it, the graceful son of Vibhāņdaka, endowed with prowess, came to that spot where he had encountered the comely courtesans, adorned with ornaments.

sa: ते तु राज्ञो वचः श्रुत्वा व्यथिता विनताननाः। न गच्छेम ऋषेीता अनुनेयन्ति तं नृपम्॥
en: Thereupon hearing the king's words, with aggrieved hearts, and with heads hanging down, they will beseech the monarch, saying, Afraid of the saint, Vibhāndaka, we shall not be able to repair thither.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं व्यादिदेश ह॥ कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण। वनेऽस्मिन्सुमहाश्वभ्रः खन्यतां रौद्रकर्मणः॥
en: Having heard that speech of Virādha, Rāghava ordered Laksmana, saying, O Laksmana, do you in this forest dig a capacious pit for this Rākṣasa resembling an elephant, dreadful, and of terrible acts.

sa: तस्मिन् पुनर्जीवति धर्मराजे विशेषतः स्वे पथि वर्तमाने। देवी मया सार्धमितोऽभिगच्छेत् कथंस्विदन्या विधवेव नारी॥
en: The righteousness monarch is still living and continues in his own path when ready to redeem his vow-even by renouncing me, how can this worshipful one accompany me like other insignificant widows?

sa: अन्तर्भूतं ततो भूतमुवाचेदं पुनर्वचः। यस्योत्सङ्गे गृहीतस्य भुजावभ्यधिकावुभौ॥ पतिष्यतः क्षितितले पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ। तृतीयमेतद् बालस्य ललाटस्थं तु लोचनम्॥ निमज्जिष्यति यं दृष्ट्वा सोऽस्य मृत्युभविष्यति। त्र्यक्षं चतुर्भुजं श्रुत्वा तथा च समुदाहृतम्॥
en: The invisible being then again said, "He, upon whose lap this child being taken, his extra arms will fall down on the ground like a pair of five headed snakes, and observing whom his third eyes on the forehead will disappear, will be his slayer." Having heard of the child's three eyes and five arms and also of the words of the invisible being.

sa: नक्षत्रे न च कुर्वीत यस्मिन् जातो भवेन्नरः। न प्रोष्ठपदयोः कार्यं तथाग्नेये च भारत॥
en: One should never perform a Shraddha under the constellation of his nativity. No Shraddha should be performed under any of the Bhadrapadas (prior or later), nor under the constellation Krittika, O Bharata.

sa: घनोपगूढं गगनं न तारा न भास्करो दर्शनमभ्युपैति। नवैर्जलौघैर्धरणी वितृप्ता तमोविलिप्ता न दिशः प्रकाशाः॥
en: The sky is enveloped with clouds and neither the sun nor the stars can be seen the earth is satisfied with new showers-and the quarters being covered with darkness cannot be seen.

sa: देवयान्युवाच दासी कन्यासहस्रेण शर्मिष्ठामभिकामये। अनु मां तत्र गच्छेत् सा यत्र दद्याच मे पिता॥
en: Devayani said : I desire to have Sharmishtha as my maidservant one thousand other damsels. She must also follow me to the house of him on whom my father will bestow me.

sa: ताभ्यामर्थ्य च पाद्यं च दत्त्वा पश्चात् फलानि च। आनुपूर्व्याच्च धर्मज्ञः पप्रच्छ कुशलं कुले॥ अयोध्यायां बले कोशे मित्रेष्वपि च मन्त्रिषु। जानन् दशरथं वृत्तं न राजानमुदाहरत्॥
en: Having offered them (the guests) water to wash their feet and Arghya, as well as fruits subsequently, that virtuous one (Bharadvāja) successively enquired after the welfare of their (respective) homes; and after that, of the forces, exchequer, friends and counsellors in Ayodhyā. And knowing that Dasaratha had departed this life, he did not ask anything relating to the monarch.

sa: यज्ञावाप्तिाह्मणस्येह नित्यं घोरे युद्धे क्षत्रियाणां यश्चा शेषौ वर्णी काममिष्टं लभेते पुत्रान् पौत्रान् नित्यमिष्टांस्तथैव॥
en: By reading it a Brahmana reaps the fruits of sacrifice, a Kshatriya obtains victory in fierce battle. The other orders (Vaishyas and Sudras) attain desirable sons and grandsons and all wishful objects.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यैर्नामधेयैः स्तुतवान् दक्षो देवं प्रजापतिः। वक्तुमर्हसि मे तात श्रोतुं श्रद्धा ममानघ॥
en: Yudhishthira said You should, O sire, tell me those names by which Daksha, that progenitor of creatures, worshipped the great god, O sinless one, a respectful curiosity urges me to hear them.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच सारस्वतानां तीर्थानां गुणोत्पात्त वदस्व मे। फलं च द्विपदां श्रेष्ठ कर्मनिर्वृत्तिमेव च॥
en: Janamejaya said Describe to me, O foremost of men, the characteristics, the origin and the merits of the several Tirthas on the Sarasvati and the rites to be performed while going there.

sa: यच्चेह किंचित् कर्तव्ये तत्सर्वं प्रापितं मया। यथोक्तं भवता काले सर्वमेव च तत् कृतम्॥
en: Whatever should be done on this occasion have all been arranged and provided for by me. Indeed, at this hour which you hadst spoken of, all things have been kept in readiness.

sa: समो न त्वं द्विजातिभ्यः श्रेयो विद्धि नराधिप। गर्भस्थान् ब्राह्मणान् सम्यङ् नमस्यति किल प्रभुः।।१०
en: You are not equal to the Brahmanas. Do you, O king, seek your own good. The Kshatriya of even great power bows to Brahmana children who are still in their mothers' wombs.

sa: तं भीमरूपं त्वरितं द्रवन्तं दुर्योधनं शत्रुसहोऽभिषगात्। प्रास्फोटयद् योद्धमनाः किरीटी बाणेन विद्धं रुधिरं वमन्तम्॥
en: While Duryodhana was thus taking to his heels, in great terror, pierced by that arrow, and throwing up blood, Kiritin, still eager for battle and capable of withstanding every enemy, censured him.

sa: किमत्र कार्यं पार्थस्य कथं वा स प्रशस्यते। अन्यत्र कामाद् द्वेषाद् वा रोषादस्मासु केवलात्॥
en: What has Partha to do with these and why should he be praised? It is so either for the desire of doing good to him or for hatred and anger towards us.

sa: च्यवनस्तु महातेजाः ब्रह्मभूतं कुलं मेऽस्तु धर्मे चास्य मनो भवेत्॥ एवमुक्तस्तथेत्येवं प्रत्युक्त्वा च्यवनो मुनिः। अभ्यनुज्ञाय नृपति तीर्थयात्रा ययौ तदा॥ एतत् ते कथितं सर्वमशेषेण मया नृप। भृगूणां कुशिकानां च अभिसम्बन्धकारणम्॥
en: Let my family become invested with the dignity of Brahmanahood, and let it always set its heart upon virtue. The ascetic Chyavana, thus solicited, granted the king's prayer, and bidding farewell to the king, started on his intended sojourn to the sacred waters. I have now told you everything, O Bharata, relating to your questions, viz., how the Bhrigus and the Kushikas became connected with each other by marriage.

sa: उक्तमेतन्मया पूर्वं द्रोणेन विदुरेण च। गान्धार्या च यशस्विन्या तत् त्वं तात न बुद्धवान्॥
en: Bhishma said Even this had been said before by myself, by Drona, by Vidura and by the illustrious lady Gandhari. But then, O Sire, you did not pay any heed to it.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच महाभूतानि यान्याहुः पञ्च धर्मभृतां वर। एकैकस्य गुणान् सम्यक् पञ्चानामपि मे वद॥
en: The Brahmana said : O foremost of all virtuous men, it is said that there are five great elements. Will you describe to me in detail the properties of those five (elements)?

sa: तया क्रुद्धया तत्रोक्त 'अयं मे पुत्रो न किंचिदपराध्यति, नावेक्षते, हवींषि, नावलेढि, किमर्थमभिहतः' इति॥
en: She angrily addressed Janamejaya thus, “My son did not commit any fault. He did not lick your sacrificial ghee, he did not even look at it. Why did you then beat him?”

sa: स एवमुक्त उपाध्यायः प्रत्युवाच 'यस्माद्भवान् केदारखण्डं विदार्योत्थितः, तस्मादुद्दालक एव नाम्ना भवान् भविष्यति इत्युपाध्यायेनानुगृहीतः॥
en: The preceptor, thus addressed, said, "As you have opened the water-course in getting from the ditch, you shall be henceforth known as Uddalaka as a mark of your action" and blessed him.

sa: अथापश्यत् पुरुषं योगयुक्तं पीताम्बरं लुब्धकोऽनेकबाहुम्॥ मत्वाऽऽत्मानं त्वपराद्धं स तस्य पादौ जरा जगृहे शंकितात्मा।
en: Coming up, Jara saw a man dressed in yellow robes, rapt in Yoga, and gifted with many arms. considering himself an offender, and filled with fear, he touched the feet of Keshava.

sa: ततो राजा न प्रभातं त्वयेच्छामि निशे नक्षत्रभूषिते॥ क्रियतां मे दया भद्रे मयायं रचितोऽञ्जलिः।
en: O night studded with stars, I beseech you, let not the morning appear. Do you, O gentle one, do me this kindness. I do thus clasp my hands (by way of supplication.)

sa: जाता वनान्ताः शिखिसुप्रनृत्ता जाताः कदम्बाः सकदम्बशाखाः। जाता वृषा गोषु समानकामा जाता मही सस्यवनाभिरामा॥
en: The peacocks are dancing at the forest skirts, the Kadamba trees are covered with flowers, the bulls have become attached to her and the earth has become charming with corns and forests.

sa: अहं गमिष्यामि वनं सुदुर्गमं मृगायुतं वानरवारणैश्च। वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर्गृहे तवैव पादावुपगृह्य सम्मता॥
en: I shall go there in that dense forest full of deers, monkeys and elephants and live there as if under my paternal roof cleaving to your feet and abiding in your pleasure.

sa: संजय उवाच राजन् शतसहस्राणि तत्र तत्र पदातिनाम्। निर्मर्यादं प्रयुद्धानि तत् ते वक्ष्यामि भारत॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, O descendant of Bharata, I shall now describe to you the fight of hundreds and thousands of foot-soldiers, who were in utter forgetfulness of all considerations for others.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा। सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेतितां शृणु॥
en: The great one said The faith of man is of three kinds. They are born according to his individual nature. They are also of Sattva, Raja, and Tama. Hear what they are.

sa: अवध्यमानास्ते चापि क्षपयन्ति बलं मम। सोऽस्मि क्षीणबलः कर्ण क्षीणशस्त्रश्च संयुगे॥ निकृतः पाण्डवैः शूरैरवध्यैर्दैवतैरपि।
en: Thus unslain, they (the Pandavas) are every day reducing my troops in great number. Therefore, O Karna, I am becoming weaker in strength, and my store of weapons is also being exhausted.

sa: उवाच ममता तं तु देवरं वदतां वरम्। अन्तर्वन्ती त्वहं भ्रात्रा ज्येष्ठेनारम्यतामिति॥
en: Mamata said to her Devara (husband's younger brother), that best of eloquent men, “I am pregnant by your elder brother; therefore you should not seek me now.

sa: परुषं ये न भाषन्ते कटुकं निष्ठुरं तथा। अपैशुन्यरताः सन्तस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who never utter words which are harsh, bitter and cruel, and who are free from deceitfulness and evil of every kind, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: गृहाणेमां मया प्रोक्तां सिद्धिं मूर्तिमतीमिव। विद्यां प्रतिस्मृति नाम प्रपन्नाय ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Accept from me this knowledge, called Pratismriti. Uttered by me it is like success personified. You are capable of accepting it; I shall tell it to you.

sa: गुरुं न हन्यां समरे ब्राह्मणं च विशेषतः। विशेषतस्तपोवृद्धमेवं क्षान्तं मया तव॥
en: I shall not slay a preceptor in battle, especially as he is a Brahmana and you have been forgiven by me since you are old in devotion.

sa: तं प्रहस्याब्रवीद्रक्ष इक्ष्वाकुं पृथिवीपतिम्। किमिदानी फलं प्राप्तं त्वया मां प्रति युद्ध्यता॥
en: Thereat the Raksasa, laughing, spoke to that Iksvāku, lord of the earth, 'What is this that you have gathered as the fruit of your encounter with me.

sa: पुलस्त्य उवाच ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र कुरुक्षेत्रमभिष्टुतम्। पापेभ्यो यत्र मुच्यन्ते दर्शनात् सर्वजन्तवः॥
en: Pulastya said: O king of kings, one should then go to Kurukshetra, adored by all and at the sight of which sins of all creatures are destroyed.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्तु तदोवाच रक्ष्यमाणास्त्वयानघ। नात्र भीता वयं सर्वे धर्ममेवानुपश्यता॥ कथं दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया। शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धं जीवितं वा सुखानि वा॥
en: Thereupon Laksmana said, O sinless one, protected by you ever having your sight fixed on virtue, we do not fear to live in this place. But how with Dasaratha's son lying down on the ground along with Sītă can I indulge in sleep or what is the use of my living and enjoying happiness?

sa: यो हि कालो व्यतिक्रामेत् पुरुषं कालकाक्षिणम्। दुर्लभः स पुनस्तेन कालः कर्मचिकीर्षुणा॥
en: If an opportunity, with respect to the man who waits for it, once goes away it can never be secured again by the person desirous of acting.

sa: तेन तत्र प्रणादेन दुःखितः स महीपतिः। चिच्छेद जीविते श्रद्धां धर्मे यशसि चात्मनः॥ स निःश्वस्योष्णमैक्ष्वाकस्तां भार्यामिदमब्रवीत्। कैकेयि कुशचीरेण न सीता गन्तुमर्हति॥
en: Aggrieved at the uproar that arose there in consequence, the lord of earth banished from his heart all regard for life, virtue, and fame. And sighing hot, that descendant of Ikşvāku spoke to that wife of his, saying, O Kaikeyi, Sītā deserves not to go in a Kuća dress.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र मिश्रकं तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र तीर्थानि राजेन्द्र मिश्रितानि महात्मना॥ व्यासेन नृपशार्दूल द्विजार्थमिति नः श्रुतम्। सर्वतीर्थेषु स स्नाति मिश्रके स्नाति यो नरः॥
en: virtuous man, one should then go to the excellent Tirtha, called Mishraka. O king of kings, in that Tirtha of the illustrious Mishrita. It has been heard by us that the Vyasa for the sake of the Brahmans mixed up all the Tirthas. The man who bathes in Mishraka bathes in all the Tirthas.

sa: अथवा तदिदं व्यक्तं यद् दृष्टं प्लवता मया। रामप्रभावादाश्चर्यं पर्वतः सरितां पतौ॥
en: Or this is clearly due to Rāma's power, even like the wonder (that I witnessed) while bounding over the main-the mountain under the lord of streams. (Mainaka)

sa: त्वमेव सर्वान् चससि पुनरेव युगक्षये। देवैरपि न शक्यस्त्वं परिज्ञातुं कुतो मया॥
en: It is you again who swallow everything at the end of the Yuga. You are incapable of being known by the celestials, what to speak of me!

sa: स गच्छन् कानने तस्मिन् हेमजालपरिष्कृतम्। ददर्श तत् सरः श्रीमान् विश्वकर्मकृतं यथा॥
en: And illustrious one, entering into the forest saw that lake beautified with gold-coloured filaments, looking as if it had been made by the Architect of the universe.

sa: मधुस्रवं च तत्रैव तीर्थं भरतसत्तम। तत्र स्नात्वा नरो राजन् गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O king, there is another Tirtha called Madhusrava. Bathing there, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: भो राजन् केन यष्टव्यमजेनाहोस्विदौषधैः॥ एतन्नः संशयं छिन्धि प्रमाणं नो भवान् मतः।
en: Should one sacrifice with the goat or with herbs and plants? Do you remove this doubt of ours! We select you as our judge in this matter.

sa: पुत्रेषु वा नतृषु वा न चेदात्मनि पश्यति। फलत्येव ध्रुवं पापं गुरुभुक्तमिवोदरे॥
en: Such fruits, are seen, either in one's ownself, or in one's son, or in one's grandson. Sin must bear fruits, like rich food they cannot be digested.

sa: राजा दशरथो नाम धर्मसेतुरिवाचलः। सत्यसंधः परिज्ञातो यस्य पुत्रः स राघवः॥ नामो नाम स धर्मात्मा त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। दीर्घबाहुर्विशालाक्षो दैवतं स पतिर्मम ॥
en: There was a king named Dasaratha, the bridge of righteousness, like to a mountain, ever bearing regard towards the truth, and renowned among men, whose son is Rāghava. He is named Rāma, and is righteous-souled and celebrated over the three worlds. he is long-armed, of expansive eyes, like to a celestial—he is my husband.

sa: यद् यत् त्यजति कामानां तत् सुखस्याभिपूर्यते। कामस्य वशगो नित्यं दुःखमेव प्रपद्यते॥
en: Inasmuch as one renounces his desires so sure is he to reap his deserts. Truly he who surrenders himself to Desire always undergoes the pangs of misery.

sa: संचितं संचितं द्रव्यं नष्टं तव पुनः पुनः। कदाचिन्मोक्ष्यसे मूढ धनेहां धनकामुक॥
en: You have now and again lost your hoarded wealth! O my wealth-covering and foolish Soul, when will you succeed in getting rid of your desire for wealth?

sa: गदं वीक्ष्य शयानं च भृशं कोपसमन्वित॥ स निःशेषं तदा चक्रे शार्ङ्गचक्रगदाधरः।
en: Seeing Gada lying dead on the ground, his anger became enhanced. The holder Sharnaga and the discus and the mace then rooted the Vrishnis and the Andhakas.

sa: क्रोधमुत्पाद्य नो भर्तुः खरस्य सुमहात्मनः। त्वमेव हास्यसे प्राणान् सद्योऽस्माभिर्हतो युधि ॥
en: Having excited there our lord. the high-souled Khara, it is you that shal: lose your life no later than this day, being slain by us in battle.

sa: एष देवो महादेवो योऽसौ पार्थ तवाग्रतः। संग्रामे शात्रवान् निघ्नंस्त्वया हृष्टः पिनाकधुक्॥
en: It is this god of gods, the paramount lord, the wielder of the Pinaka bow, O Partha, whom you have seen go before you slaying your enemies.

sa: यनिर्दहति यत् तीक्ष्णो यदुग्रो यत् प्रतापवान्। मांसशोणितमज्जादो यत् ततो रुद्र उच्यते॥
en: As he burns, as he is keen and fierce and endued with the great prowess and as he devours flesh, blood and marrow, he is called Rudra.

sa: धूम्ररूपं च यत् तस्य धूर्जटिस्तेन चोच्यते। विश्वेदेवाश्च यत् तस्मिन् विश्वरूपस्ततः स्मृतः॥१२९
en: As his form is like that of smoke he is called Dhurjati; and as the Devas in the world are present in him he is called Vishvarupa.

sa: पितृयज्ञास्तथा कूपाः प्रपाश्च शयनानि च। दानानि च यथाकालं द्विजेभ्यो विसृजेत् सदा॥
en: They should celebrate sacrifices in honour of the departed manes, dig wells, for the public give water to thirsty travellers, distribute beds and other presents amongst Brahmanas.

sa: पुराणे हि कथा दिव्या आदिवंशाश्च धीमताम्। कथ्यन्ते ये पुराऽस्माभिः श्रुतपूर्वाः पितुस्तव।॥
en: There are in the Puranas interesting stories and the history of the first generations of the wise men. We have heard them all recited by your father.

sa: इत्येवमुक्ते वचनेऽर्जुनेन ब्राह्मणाः सर्ववर्णाश्च राजन्। मुदाभ्यनन्दन सहिताश्च चक्रुः प्रदक्षिणधर्मभृतां वरिष्ठम्॥ ते
en: O king, at these words of Arjuna, the Brahmanas and the men of other orders saluted him cheerfully and walked round that foremnost of all virtuous men.

sa: एवं तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा मातापुत्रौ तपोवने॥ जग्मतुस्त्रिदिवं राम कृतार्थाविति नः श्रुतम्।
en: And it has been heard by us that having thus ascertained in that hermitage, the mother and the son, O Rama, went to heaven, their desire obtained.

sa: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत्। स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वारड्मयं तप उच्यते॥
en: The words that does not disturb any body and which is agreeable, true and beneficial, and the diligent study of the Vedas, is the penance of speech.

sa: शुचानि श्रवणीयानि शृणोमीह धनंजय। न च पापानि गृह्णामि ततोऽहं वै शुचिश्रवाः॥
en: I always hear words that are pure and holy, O Dhananjaya, and never catch anything that is sinful. Hence am I called by the name of Shuchishravas.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिन्नतिरथे द्रोणे निहते पार्षतेन वै। मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वन्नतः परम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When that Atiratha, viz., Drona had been slain by the son of Prisata, O Sanjaya, did my troops and those of the Pandavas do afterwards?

sa: स तं गत्वा क्षणेनैव पर्वतं वचनापितुः। अमुञ्चन्महतीं शाखां सस्वनं तत्र खेचरः॥
en: Going almost within a moment to the mountains as directed by his father, the bird let fall the great bough. And it fell with a great noise.

sa: राज्ञो रहस्यं यद् वाक्यं जयार्थं लोकसंग्रहः। हृदि यच्चास्य जिह्यं स्यात्कारणेन च यद् भवेत्॥ यच्चास्य कार्यं वृजिनमार्जवेनैव धारयेत्। दम्भनार्थं च लोकस्य धर्मिष्ठामाचरेत् क्रियाम्॥
en: The secret speeches of a king, the collecting of troops for the purposes of victory, the wily purposes in his heart, desires for accomplishing particular objects, and the wrong acts he does or intends to do, should be concealed by assuming a bold appearance. He should act righteously for keeping his people under control.

sa: महोदरं महेष्वासं नाराचेन स्तनान्तरे। विव्याध समरे राजन् स हतो न्यपतद् भुवि॥
en: He also pierced the mighty car-warrior Mahendra with a long shaft between his breasts, and O king, (thus stricken), the latter fell down dead on the ground.

sa: दयया यदि वा राजन् द्वेष्यभावान्मम प्रभो। मन्दभाग्यतया वापि मम रक्षसि पाण्डवान्॥
en: As also the Somakas, all fierce bowmen. Prove, O Bharata, the truth of your words. But if out of mercy, or out of your hatred, O lord,

sa: अपरे क्षत्रियाः शूराः कृतवैराः परस्परम्। नैव शस्त्रं विमुञ्चन्ति नैव क्रन्दन्ति मारिष॥
en: O exalted one, but there were others, the brave Kshatriyas, who having wounded one another, did not abandon their weapons nor did they set up any wails,

sa: एवमेतेन भाव्यं हि नूनं कार्वेण तत्त्वतः। यथा ह्यस्येदृशी निष्ठा कृतकार्येऽपि दुष्करे॥
en: Truly, this is the end of which such acts leads. Although the Pandavas have achieved such difficult feats, yet this should be the result of those feats.

sa: ततोऽन्तक इव क्रुद्धः सवज्र इव वासवः। दण्डपाणिगि मह्यो मृत्युः कालेन चोदितः॥
en: Then, ikt, the enraged Destroyer or like Vasata arnted with the thunderbolt or like the unbearate'r god of Death wielding his bludgeon and lét loose by time.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रेण सर्वे तस्मे निवेदितम्। स हत्वा सैन्धवं संख्ये पुनरेतु धनंजयः॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) has also employed them all in the protection of his (Jayadratha). May Dhananjaya return safe, having slain the ruler of the Sindhus!

sa: इति संकल्प्यतां बुद्ध्या शरीरार्द्ध ममार्जुनः। यथा त्वं मे प्रभातायामस्यां निशि रथोत्तमम्॥ कल्पयित्वा यथाशास्त्रमादाय व्रज संयतः। गदा कौमोदकी दिव्यां शक्तिं चक्रं धनुः शरान्॥
en: With the help of your intelligence, do you identify Arjuna to be the half of my ownself. When the day dawns, O Daruka, equipping my best of chariots according to the rules of military science, you must bring it and follow me carefully. My mace Kaumodaki of celestial discus and my bow and arrows.

sa: भ्रातुरर्थे महाबाहो कुरु कर्म सुदुष्करम्। मयैवं नोक्तपूर्वो हि भ्राता कश्चित्परंतप ॥
en: O long-armed one, do you perform your dearest acts in behalf of your brother. O subduer of enemies, I had never before said so to my brother.

sa: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिंदम। कस्मिंश्चित् संवृते देशे विश्रान्तः श्वो गमिष्यसि॥
en: If you wish it, O hero, do you, O subduer of enemies, stay here for one day. Having rested in some hidden nook, you will depart tomorrow.

sa: यदि त्वभिहितं राज्ञा त्वयि तन्न विपत्स्यते। ततोऽहमभिधास्यामि न ह्येष त्वयि वक्ष्यति॥
en: If what I, with the king's permission, speak to you, does not go useless, I shall speak to you all; the king will not speak any thing.

sa: या त्वं विरहिता नीता चलचित्तेन रक्षसा। दैवसंपादितो दोषो मानुषेण मया जितः॥
en: That accidental misfortune, under the influence where of you were carried away by the fickle-minded Räksasa in my absence, has been subdued today by me, a man.

sa: ततः प्राची दिशं भीमो ययौ भीमपराक्रमः। सैन्येन महता राजन् कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: O king, causing the earth itself to tremble with the tread of the mighty army that followed him, then Bhima of fearful velour marched towards the east.

sa: पानीयस्य क्रिया नक्तं न कार्या भूतिमिच्छता। वर्जनीयाश्चैव नित्यं सक्तवो निशि भारत॥
en: One should not bathe at night, if he seeks his own aggrandisement. One should also, O Bharata, always abstain from the flour of fried barley at night.

sa: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्न सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। मनः संकल्पसम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः॥ येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक् सज्जते गतिः। न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः॥
en: And exceedingly powerful and mighty monkeys possessed of prowess, and speeding far with the rapidity of thought, are in his command. Nothing can impede their courses, either upward, or downward, or tending in both directions, and those ones of measureless energy never experience depression in the most arduous undertakings.

sa: नाग उवाच आश्चर्याणामनेकानां प्रतिष्ठा भगवान् रविः। यतो भूताः प्रवर्तन्ते सर्वे त्रैलोक्यसम्मताः॥
en: The Naga said, The divine Sun is the refuge or home of numberless wonders. All the creatures that inhabit the three worlds have sprung from the Sun.

sa: अन्योन्यभुजसूत्रेण स्त्रीमाला ग्रथिता हि सा। मालेव ग्रथिता सूत्रे शुशुभे मत्तषट्पदा ॥
en: That garland of females strung by the threads of their hands, appeared beauteous, like a real wreath strung on a thread, with maddened black bees (seated thereon).

sa: एतांस्तु धर्मान् गार्हस्थ्यान् यः कुर्यादनसूयकः। स इहर्षिवरान् प्राण्य प्रेत्य लोके महीयते॥
en: The householder, who performs these ceremonies with mind shorn of passion, obtains the blessings of the Rishis in this world, and after death acquires the heavenly regions.

sa: न चाप्येवं त्वया भूयः क्षेप्तव्या ब्रह्मवादिनः। न चावमान्या दोत्ते वाग्वज्रा भृशकोपनाः॥
en: But let not the utterers of Brahma, Brahmanas be ever slighted by you. Let not those, whose words are like the thunderbolt, be again insulted by you."

sa: बाढं कल्यं गमिष्यामि ह्येकः सारथिना सह। आनेष्यामि च वेदेहीमिमां दृष्टो महापुरीम्॥
en: Excellent well. I will go there alone, accompanied by my charioteer only. I will this very morning with a glad heart bring Vaidehi to this spacious palace.

sa: प्रमाणं यत् स्ववेदोक्तं शास्त्रोक्तं यच्च पठ्यते। वेदशास्त्रद्वयं चैव प्रमाणं तत् सनातनम्॥
en: Whatever is read as said in the Vedas and in other scriptures is considered as authority. The authority, again, of the Vedas and other scriptures, is eternal.

sa: विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यमारुरोह महाकपिः। तत्रस्थः सर्वतो गन्धं पानभक्ष्यान्नसम्भवम्॥ दिव्यं सम्मूर्च्छितं जिघ्रन् रूपवन्तमिवानिलम्। स गन्धस्तं महासत्त्वं वन्धुर्बन्धुमिवोत्तमम्॥ इत एहीत्युवाचेव तत्र यत्र स रावणः।
en: And stationed thereon, Hanumān smelt the rich odour of viands and drinks that was spreading on all sides; and like one dear friend smelling another, he also smelt the mighty Air, impregnated with aroma, which seemed like embodied Odour. And (the Air) said to Hanumãn, "Come here, where that Rāvana is." 'i.e. on Puspaka.

sa: तैर्मुक्तकेशैः समरे पतितैः शोणितोक्षितैः । विस्तीर्णा वसुधा कृत्स्ना महावेदिः कुशैरिव ॥
en: And as a spacious dais is covered with Kusa, the entire field was scattered with the Rākṣasas fallen in battle with hair dishevelled, and covered with blood.

sa: पितुर्नियोगमादाय जगाम मिथिलां नृप। प्रष्टुं धर्मस्य निष्ठां वै मोक्षस्य च परायणम्॥
en: Bearing the command of his father, O king, Shuka, proceeded to Mithila for enquiring of its king about the truth of duties and the Refuge of Liberation.

sa: रुद्रवत् प्रचरिष्यन्ति तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः। सर्व एव महात्मानः शालस्तम्भा इवोद्गताः॥
en: They will roam about like so many Rudras, of that there is no doubt. All of them are great-souled and tall as the trunks of Shala trees.

sa: ततो ब्रह्मादयो देवा दक्षश्चैव प्रजापतिः॥ ऊचुः प्राज्जलयः सर्वे कथ्यतां को भवानिति।
en: Then the gods headed by Brahman, and that progenitor of creatures, viz., Daksha, joining their hands in reverence, addressed that powerful Being, saying,-"Tell us, who you are."

sa: व्यास उवाच युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो वेद्मि ते हृदयस्थितम्। मनीषया ततः क्षिप्रमागतोऽस्मि नरर्षभ॥
en: Vyasa said : O mighty-armed Yudhishthira, O best of men, knowing by my intelligence what is passing in your mind, I have speedily come to this place.

sa: अयं स्त्रीपूर्वको राजच्छिखण्डी यदि ते उद्योगे कथितं यत्तत् तथा जाता शिखण्डिनी॥
en: Before the commencement of the battle I have told you, and you have heard that this Shikhandin was born formerly as a female and was called Shikhandin.

sa: भीष्मः शान्तनवो राजन् भागः क्लृप्तः शिखण्डिनः। तं विराटोऽनुसंयाता सार्धं मत्स्यैः प्रहारिभिः॥
en: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, O king, has been reserved as the share of Shikhandin. Virata will help him (the latter) along with the soldiers from Matsya.

sa: वेदेषु धर्मशास्त्रेषु मिथ्या यो वै द्विजातिषु। देवेषु पितृधर्मेषु सोऽक्षयं नरकं व्रजेत्॥
en: He, (also), who imputes falsehood to the Vedas, the religious books, the twice-born ones, the gods and the religion of his fore fathers goes to eternal hell.

sa: स तं समयमाश्रित्य राज्यं नेच्छति पैतृकम्। बलमाश्रित्य मत्स्यानां पञ्चालानां च मूर्खवत्॥
en: He now, like a fool disregarding that stipulation, wants his paternal wealth depending on the armies supplied him by the Matsyas and by the king of Panchala.

sa: श्रिया विहीना राष्ट्राच्च विनष्टाः शाश्वतीः समाः। अलं ते पाण्डुपुत्राणां भक्त्या क्लेशमुपासितुम्॥
en: The sons of Pandu have forever fallen from their high dignity and have lost their kingdom? You should not therefore, out of regard, participate in their miseries.

sa: अधीत्य ब्राह्मणो वेदान् याजयेत यजेत वा। क्षत्रियो धनुराश्रित्य यजेच्चैव न याजयेत्॥
en: Having studied the Vedas, the Brahmanas should perform sacrifices and officiate as priests. Resorting to their vows the Kshatriyas should perform sacrifices and never officiate as priests.

sa: सहायवानस्मि रणे युध्येयममरैरपि। साध्वसं हि प्रणष्टं मे किं करोमि ब्रवीहि मे।॥
en: I have now got one to help me in battle; I can fight with the immortals. My fears have been dispelled. Tell me what I shall do.

sa: पुरा युद्धात् साधु मन्ये पाण्डवैः सह संगतम्। यद् वाक्यमर्जुनेनोक्तं संजयेन निवेदितम्॥
en: Before the battle, I think that peace with the Pandavas seems to be the best. What has been prophesied by Arjuna and submitted to us by Sanjaya.

sa: धौम्य उवाच नेयं शक्या त्वया नेतुमविजित्य महारथान्। धर्मं क्षत्रस्य पौराणमवेक्षस्व जयद्रथ॥
en: Dhaumya said : Without defeating the mighty car-warriors she should not be taken away by you; O Jayadratha, you should observe this ancient custom of the Kshatriyas.

sa: स मासः पञ्चरात्रेण पूर्णो भवितुमर्हति। ततः श्रोष्यसि रामेण सहितः सुमहत् प्रियम्॥
en: That month will be complete in another five nights. And then you will, together with Rama, hear that great and joyful news about the discovery of Sita)."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ददानीत्येव भगवानुत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत। अन्यं वरय भद्रं ते वरं त्वममरोपम॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon, that exalted one replied “ I give (you this boon). Be blessed. Do you who are like an immortal ask for another boon.

sa: तान् बद्ध्वा धर्मपाशैश्च स्वैश्च पाशैर्जलेश्वरः। वरुणः सागरे यत्तो नित्यं रक्षति दानवान्॥
en: Having bound them with the aids of Dharma as also by his own power, the lord of the caters, Varuna keeps the Danavas ever in the sea.

sa: यस्य दानजितं मित्रं शत्रवो युधि निर्जिताः। अन्नपानजिता दाराः सफलं तस्य जीवितम्॥
en: He, whose friends have been won by gifts, whose enemies vanquished in battle, whose wife won over by food and drink, has his life crowned with success.

sa: तव धर्माश्रिता बुद्धिस्तेषां वैराश्रया मतिः। यदयुद्धेन लभ्येत तत् ते बहुमतं भवेत्॥
en: Your intentions are established on virtue; while their purposes are based on malice. What is gained by not having recourse to war, is much in your estimate.

sa: अग्नौ हुत्वा समुत्पाद्य घोरं वृत्रमुवाच ह। इन्द्रशत्रो विवर्धस्व प्रभावात् तपसो मम॥
en: And having made his offerings to fire and having created the hero Vritra said-"O you foe of Indra, grow up through the strength due to my devotions."

sa: कण्व उवाच गरुडस्तत्र शुश्राव यथावृत्तं महाबलः। आयुःप्रदानं शक्रेण कृतं नागस्य भारत॥
en: Kanya said In the meantime Garuda endued with great might, heard what had happened, namely the bestowal of a long life on the Naga by Shakra, OBharata.

sa: तक्षोवाच कं भवन्तमहं विद्यां घोरकर्माणमद्य वै। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं तत्त्वेन कथयस्व मे॥
en: The wood cutter said I must know who you are and I want to hear why you have done this cruel deed today. Tell me the truth.

sa: नवद्वारमिदं वेश्म त्रिस्थूणं पञ्चसाक्षिकम्। क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं विद्वान् यो वेद स परः कविः॥
en: This house has nine doors, three pillars and five witnesses presided over by the soul. That learned man who knows this is the best of the wise.

sa: इमं तावन्ममैकं त्वं बाहुं सव्येतरं वह। यद्येनं धारयस्येकं सफलं ते विकस्थितम्॥
en: To prove your words, bear the weight of my right arm and if you can carry it then what you say will have some reason in it."

sa: तस्याद्य कुरुवीरस्य न विज्ञातं वचो मया। तन्मे दहति गात्राणि तदकार्षित् प्रजागरम्॥
en: This day was I unable to know (the nature of) the message of the hero among the Kurus; therefore is my body burning, which has caused sleeplessness.

sa: शल्य उवाच शृणु राजन् पुरावृत्तमितिहासं पुरातनम्। सभार्येण यथा प्राप्तं दुःखमिन्द्रेण भारत॥
en: Shalya said O king, listen to this old story as related in ancient history, of how Indra with his queen met with difficulties, O son of Bharata.

sa: अहं ते सर्वमाख्यास्ये दर्शयन् वसुधातलम्। दृष्ट्वा तत्र वरं कंचिद् रोचयिष्याव मातले॥
en: While showing you the nether regions of the earth, I shall describe to you everything; and after a search there we shall select some bridegroom, O Matali.

sa: अथ तत्रापि पद्मानि विचिन्वन् भरतर्षभ। अपश्यत् स तु देवेन्द्र बिसमध्यगतं स्थितम्॥
en: And there searching among the lotuses, O you foremost in the race of Bharata, he saw at last the king of gods, in one of the stalks.

sa: सैरभ्युवाच अतीव तेषां घृणिनामर्थेऽहं धर्मचारिणी। तस्य तस्यैव ते वध्या येषां ज्येष्ठोऽक्षदेविता॥
en: Sairandhri said I practise piety for their sake who are extremely kind. They, of whom the eldest is addicted to dice, are to be oppressed by all.

sa: दुर्योधनेन यद्येतत् पापं तेषु पुरा कृतम्। त्वया तत् कुलवृद्धेन प्रत्यानेनं नरेश्वर॥
en: If this wrong has been done towards them by Duryodhana in the first instance, it is your duty, being the foremost of his race, to undo it.

sa: न जानासि यथा दृष्ट्वा चीराजिनधरान् वने। तवापि मन्युरुद्भूतो दुःखितान् प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवान्॥
en: Do you not know that you, too seeing the Pandavas clad in rags and deer skin in the forest, felt very sorry and your wrath was kindled

sa: वैशम्पयान उवाच एवं प्रमुदितः पार्थः कृष्णेन सहितस्तदा। वृतो दशाहप्रवरैः पुनरायाद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Being thus rendered glad, the son of Pritha, in company with Krishna and surrounded by the chiefs of the Dasharha race, came back to Yudhishthira.

sa: किरीटी बलवान् पार्थः कृतास्त्रश्च महारथः। को हि पाण्डुसुतं युद्धे विषहेत धनंजयम्॥
en: These sons, of Pandu, have doubtless borne much troubles here and in the forest and rightly speaking they are doubtless entitled to the wealth of their fathers.

sa: आपदर्थं धनं रक्षेद् दारान् रक्षेद् धनैरपि। आत्मानं सततं रक्षेद् दारैरपि धनैरपि॥
en: To ward off difficulties one should possess wealth; by wealth one should protect his wife; and one's own self should ever be protected by wife and wealth,

sa: अनेकजयिनौ संख्यै यौ वै पुरुषसत्तमौ। तयोस्त्वं न समो राजन् भविताऽसि कदाचन।॥
en: There are two persons who are the best among men and who have achieved many victories in battle; you are by no means equal to them, Oking.

sa: यो वै कश्चिदिहाजातः क्षत्रियः क्षत्रकर्मवित्। भयाद् वृत्तिसमीक्षो वा न नमेदिह कस्यचित्॥
en: The Kshatriya, who is born in this world knowing the duties of a Kshatriya, does not bow to any one from fear or from consideration of livelihood.

sa: न चापि ह्यकरोद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा कृष्ण सुयोधनः। युधिष्ठिरस्य दाशार्ह श्रीमतः संधिमिच्छतः॥
en: Suyodhana, though he heard these words of Yudhishthira endued with prosperity and desirous if peace, did not act up to them, O you of the Dasharha race.

sa: ते सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा तत् सर्वं पूर्वकिल्बिषम्। सामैव कुरुभिः सार्धमिच्छन्ति कुरुपुङ्गवाः॥
en: Forgetting all these troubles gone through by them in past times those foremost, among the race of Kuru, are desirous of peace with the son of Kuru.

sa: स त्वं परिवृतः पार्थैर्नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः। प्रशाधि राज्यं कौन्तेष कुन्तीं च प्रतिनन्दय॥
en: Surrounded by the sons of Pritha as the moon is by the stars, rule over this kingdom, O son of Kunti and delight the heart of Kunti.

sa: जिघांसन्तं नरव्याघ्रमर्जुनं तिग्मतेजसम्। आचार्यमुख्यः समरे द्रोणः शस्त्रभृतां वरः। अर्जुनेन सहाक्रीडच्छरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि वर्षन्तं तस्मिन् वै तुमुले रणे। अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य फाल्गुनं समयोधयत्॥ तयोरासीत् सम्प्रहारः क्रुद्धयोर्नरसिंहयोः। अमर्षिणोस्तदान्योन्यं देवदानवयोरिव॥ ऐन्द्र वायव्यमाग्नेयमस्त्रमस्त्रेण पाण्डवः। द्रोणेन मुक्तमानं तु ग्रसति स्म पुनः पुनः॥ एवं शूरौ महेष्वासौ विसृजन्तौ शिताञ्छरान्। एकच्छायं चक्रतुस्तावाकाशं शरवृष्टिभिः॥ तत्रार्जुनेन मुक्तानां पततां वै शरीरिषु
en: (Beholding) Arjuna, the foremost of men, of fierce energy, discharging celestials weapons in that great battle and killing (soldiers) the foremost of preceptors and warriors Drona, played with Arjuna with arrows of depressed knots. And warding off his weapons with his, Bharadvaja's son fought with Arjuna. Then there ensued an encounter between those two foremost of men, worked up with anger and striking each other, like that between the celestials and demons. Arjuna repeatedly warded off with his own, the weapons Aindra, Vayavya and Agneya discharged by Drona. Shooting sharp arrows, those two great heroes converted the sky, with a shade. Coming down on the bodies of the enemy's heroes, the shafts, discharged by Arjuna, made a sound like that of thunderbolt striking against a mountain. Then

sa: यदि भीमार्जुनौ कृष्ण कृपणौ संधिकामुकौ। पिता मे योत्स्यते वृद्धः सह पुत्रैर्महारथैः॥
en: If Bhima and Arjuna, O Krishna, are so mean as to desire peace, then my old father will fight along with his sons who are great car-warriors.

sa: कर्ण उवाच राजन्नाधावगच्छामि तवेह लघुसत्त्वताम्। किमत्र चित्रं यद् वीर मोक्षितः पाण्डवैरसि॥
en: Karna said.: O king, your today's conduct is childish. O hero, what is to be wondered at in all this, that you were rescued by the Pandavas.

sa: रौद्र रुद्राद्रहं शस्त्रं वारुणं वरुणादपि। अस्त्रमाग्नेयमग्नेश्च वायव्यं मातरिश्वनः। वज्रादीनि तथास्त्राणि शक्रादहमवाप्तवान्॥
en: I have obtained from Rudra, the Rudra, from Varuna the Varuna from Agni, the Agneya, from Vayu, the Vayavya, and from Indra the thunderbolt and other weapons.

sa: राजन् न प्रजानन्त दिशं काञ्चन मोहिताः॥ ततो द्रौणिर्महावीर्यः पार्थस्य विचरिष्यतः। विवरं सूक्ष्ममालोक्य ज्यां चिच्छेद क्षुरेण ह। तदस्यापूजयन् देवाः कर्म दृष्ट्वातिमानुषम्॥
en: Were so bewildered, that they could not make out which way to go. Then finding out the weak point of Partha, who was roving about, the highly powerful son of Drona cut off his bow-string with a sharp arrow. Beholding his superhuman deed, the deities spoke highly of him.

sa: ततस्तथोक्तं पितरं रामो विज्ञाय वीर्यवान्। वनं प्रतस्थे धर्मात्मा राजा सत्यो भवत्विति॥
en: Learning that his father has been thus promise-bound and considering that the king's truth ought to remain inviolable, the virtuous and powerful Rama went into the forests.

sa: इह प्राज्ञो हि पुरुषः स्वल्पमप्रियमिच्छति। यस्य स्वल्पं प्रियं लोके ध्रुवं तस्याल्पमप्रियम्॥
en: In this world a wise man regards little as undesirable; the man to whom little is sufficient soon becomes weary of that little (and wishes for more).

sa: अङ्गेमां समवेक्षस्व पुत्र स्वामेव वाहिनीम्। जात एष तवाभावस्त्वं तु मोहान बुध्यसे॥
en: Think well, O son, of the elements of your own army; it has been collected for your own death; you do not accept this out of folly.

sa: नृशंसेन च वो युक्तांस्त्यजेयं शाश्वतीः समाः। काले हि समनुप्राप्ते त्यक्तव्यमपि जीवनम्॥
en: When the suitable moment arrives, life even should be laid down. The two sons of Madri who are ever attached to virtuous deeds should be spoken to.

sa: सुदेष्णोवाच नैवंरूपा भवन्त्येव यथा वदसि भामिनि। प्रेषयन्तीव वै दासीर्दासांश्च विविधान् बहून्॥
en: Sudeshna said It cannot be so as you say, O beautiful one, (but on the contrary) it seems you can appoint numerous servants both male and female.

sa: क्लेशिता हि त्वया पार्था धर्मपाशसितास्तदा। सभायां द्रौपदी चैव तैश्च तन्मर्षितं तव॥
en: The sons of Pritha had been persecuted by you in the Assembly-hall, but being bound by the ties of virtue they over-looked all that at the time.

sa: मत्प्रसादाच्च वः सर्वान् विराटनगरे स्थितान्॥ न प्रज्ञास्यन्ति कुरवो नरा वा तन्निवासिनः।
en: Through my grace neither the Kurus nor the people inhabiting the city of Virata, will be able to recognize you all during your stay in that city.

sa: यत्र यत्रैनमासीनं शङ्करन् दुष्टचारिणः। न तत्रोपविशेद् यो वै स राजवसतिं वसेत्॥
en: He alone can live in a royal house who sits on a seat the occupation of which cannot create any suspicion in the minds of the wicked.

sa: ततो द्वादश वर्षाणि प्रवेष्टव्यं वने पुनः। एकस्मिन्नपि विज्ञाते प्रतिज्ञातं हि नस्तथा॥
en: And if any one of us be discovered we hall have to enter the forest again for another twelve years, for that has truly been our promise.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच धनंजय समुद्यम्य पाञ्चालीं वह भारत। राजधान्यां निवत्स्यामो विमुक्ताश्च वनादितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said 0 Dhananjaya, o Bharata, take up Panchali and carry her. As we are come out of this forest we shall settle ourselves in the capital.

sa: येन त्वेतानि सर्वाणि संगृहीतानि भारत। यद् बलानां बलं श्रेष्ठं तत् प्रज्ञाबलमुच्यते॥
en: That by which all these are collected, O Bharata, the strength which is superior to all sorts of strength, is said to be the strength of intellect.

sa: सुकुमारो युवा शूरो दर्शनीयश्च पाण्डवः भ्रातृणां चैव सर्वेषां प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः॥
en: That heroic and delicate youth, that son of Pandu, well worth a gaze, is the life itself to all his brothers, though he has a different body.

sa: शक्यं किमन्यद् वक्तुं ते दानादन्यज्जनेश्वर। ब्रुवन्तु ते महीपालाः सभायां ये समासते॥
en: What else are you capable of saying to them than giving back their kingdom? Let the protectors of the earth who are assembled in this council, speak.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शयानं कौन्तेयं रात्रौ द्वैतवने मृगाः। स्वप्नान्ते दर्शयामासुर्वाष्पकण्ठा युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : One day, when Yudhishthira was sleeping at night in the Dvaitavana, some deer with accents choked in tears appeared before him in his dreams.

sa: अत्र गाथा पुरा गीता रसातलनिवासिभिः। पौराणी श्रूयते लोके गीयते या मनीषिभिः॥
en: The song, that was sung here in days of old by the inhabitants of Rasatala, is still heard to be sung in this world by wise men.

sa: संतापित: पिता माता वयं चैव नृपात्मज! कस्मादिति न जानीमस्तत् सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: O Prince, we can not make out why you have given so much pain to your father, mother and ourselves also. You ought to relate all this.

sa: कुतः पुष्टानि मित्राणि कुतोऽर्थाः संचयः कुतः। हयानां चन्द्रशुभ्राणां शतान्यष्टौ कुतो मम॥
en: Where can I get well-to-do friends? Where can I have wealth froin? Where are my saving? Eight hundred horses white as the moon where can I get?

sa: आसां तु पयसा मिश्रं पयो निर्मथ्य सागरे। मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा देवैरसुरसंहितैः॥ उद्धृता वारुणी लक्ष्मीरमृतं चापि मातले। उच्चैःश्रवाश्चाश्वराजो मणिरत्नं च कौस्तुभम्॥
en: The gods united with the Asuras, having churned the water of the ocean, mixed with milk, making the Mandara (mountain) their churning rod, extracted the Varuni wine, Lakshmi (the goddess of beauty and wealth) and nectar, O Matali and also the best of horses, Uchchaishrava and that gem Kaustubha.

sa: त्वया हि मम सत्पुत्र यशो दीप्तमुपार्जितम्। जित्वा वलाधरं संख्ये सहस्राक्षं शचीपतिम्॥
en: O my dutiful son, by conquering the thousand-eyed wielder of the Vajra (thunderbolt), the husband of Sachi, in battle, you have acquired a blazing renown for me.

sa: का त्ववस्था तयोरद्य मदर्थमिति चिन्तये। तयोरदृश्ये मयि च महद् दुःखं भविष्यति॥
en: I am now reflecting as to what a state they will be reduced for my sake. Surely, they will be sorely afflicted on account of my absence.

sa: संयुगे वै महाराज दृश्यते सुमहान् क्षयः। क्षये चोभयतो राजन् कं धर्ममनुपश्यसि॥
en: In the case of a fight, O great king, you will see a great loss and in loss to both parties what meritorious deed do you see?

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं क्षिप्रं त्वया दत्तं परंतप। एष मे सर्वलाभानां लाभः परमको मतः॥
en: O tormentor of foes, I wish you will very soon give them to me, as I consider this one gain to be the best of all others.

sa: बन्धुरात्माऽऽत्मनस्तस्य येनैवात्माऽऽत्मना जितः। स एव नियतो बन्धुः स एव नियतो रिपुः॥
en: He, by whom self has been subjugated by self and has himself for his friend; for himself is ever his friend and himself is ever his enemy.

sa: तस्य पुत्र पुरे जातः संवृद्धश्च तपोवने। सत्यवाननुरूपो मे भर्तेति मनसा वृतः॥
en: His son, Satyavana (by name), born in the city and brought up in the hermitage, is my fit husband and I have wedded him in my mind.

sa: यक्ष उवाच किं स्विदादित्यमुन्नयति के च तस्याभितश्चराः। कश्नमस्तं नयति कस्मिश्च प्रतितिष्ठति॥
en: The Yaksha said: What is that which makes Aditya, (the sun) rise? Who remain near him? Who does make him set? (And) in what is he established?

sa: इमे त्वां तारयिष्यन्ति दृष्टमेतत् पुरातने। अहं ते दुहिता राजन् माधवी मृगचारिणी॥
en: These will save you-such an example has been seen in days of old-I am your daughter, Madhvi, who, o king, have adopted the life of a deer.

sa: अहल्या थर्षिता पूर्वमृषिपत्नी यशस्विनी। जीवतो भर्तुरिन्द्रेण स वः किं न निवारितः॥
en: Ahalya, the wife of a Rishi (herself) of good reputation, was ravished by Indra while her husband was alive. Why was he not then prevented by you.

sa: सर्वे ते दावृतज्ञाना नाभ्यजानन्त तं नृपम्। स मुहूर्तादथ नृपो हतौजाश्चाभवत् तदा॥
en: None of them was then in proper senses and did know that ruler of men, and speedily was that ruler of men shorn of his heavenly effulgence.

sa: सत्रेण नूनं छन्नं हि चरन्तं पार्थमर्जुनम्। उत्तर: सारथिं नगराद् बहिः॥ स नो मन्यामहे दृष्ट्वा भीत एष पलायते। तं नूनमेष धावन्तं जिघृक्षति धनंजयः॥
en: He has come out of childishness and not of heroism. Uttara must have issued out of the city making Arjuna the son of Pritha his charioteer who is living in disguise. It appears to us that he, seeing us, is flying away in fear. And forsooth Dhananjaya is following him to bring him back.

sa: उपायः को नु भवतां मतः सागरलडने। इयं हि महती सेना सागरचातिदुस्तरः॥
en: “This army is vast and the ocean too is very difficult to cross. What steps, therefore, in your opinion, should be taken in order to cross it?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं बहुविधैर्वाक्यैर्याच्यमानः स तु द्विजः। कर्णेन भरतश्रेष्ठ नान्यं वरमयाचत॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O best of the Bharatas, though Karna thus entreated that twice-born one with various words, yet he (the Brahmana) did not crave any other boon.

sa: अर्थांस्त्यजत पात्रेभ्युः सुतान् प्राप्नुत कामजान्। प्रियं प्रियेभ्यश्चरत राजा हि त्वरते जये॥
en: Distribute wealth among proper recipients; get desirable sons and serve those that are dear to you by doing them good; for the king is anxious for victory.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततस्तत्रैव रामस्य समासीनस्य तैः सह। समाजग्मुः कपिश्रेष्ठाः सुग्रीववचनात् तदा।॥
en: Markandeya said : Then while Rama was seated at that very place with them (the monkeys), the monkeychiefs, at the command of Sugriva, began to assemble there.

sa: दायादं मत्स्यराजस्य कुले जातं मनस्विनाम्। त्वां कथं निन्दितं कर्म कारयेयं नृपात्मज॥
en: O prince, why should I make you do a cursed deed, born as you are of a noble family and a heir to the king of Matsya's.

sa: क्षपयित्वा तु तं कालं गणितं कालचोदिताः। सावशेषेण कालेन सम्भवन्ति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Passing their fixed time in heaven and hell, and with some portion of their merits and demerits unexhausted, they again and again take birth, moved by Time.

sa: तत्र निर्जित्य संग्रामे मानुषान् देवतास्तथा। वरं क्रतुं समाजहे वरुणः परवीरहा॥ तस्मिन् क्रतुवरे वृत्ते संग्राम: समजायत। देवानां दानवानां च त्रैलोक्यस्य भयावहः॥
en: Having in battle subjugated both men and celestials and Gandharvas and Rakshasas, Varuna, O king, that slayer of hostile heroes, celebrated his grand sacrifice in that Tirtha. Upon the commencement of that foremost of sacrifices a baitle took place between the gods and the Danavas, terrorising the three worlds.

sa: को हि राज्यं परित्यज्य सर्वस्वं चात्मना सह। प्रव्रज्यायैव दीव्येत विना दुर्दूतदेविनम्॥
en: Who else, except him, addicted sore to gambling, would play, renouncing kingdom and every thing including his self, in order to lead a life in the forest?

sa: व्यास उवाच राजन् परीतकालास्ते पुत्राश्चान्ये च पार्थिवाः। ते हिंसन्तीव संग्रामे समासाद्येतरेतरम्॥
en: Vyasa said O king, the (last) moment of your sons and of other kings has arrived. They have assembled to fight and they will kill one another.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्तस्तदाचार्यः प्रत्युवाच स्मयन्निव। मामजित्वा न बीभत्यो शक्यो जेतुं जयद्रथः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus spoken to, the preceptors then smilingly replied unto Arjuna thus-Vibhatsu you shall not conquer Jayadratha without in the first instance conquering my own self.”

sa: यदि त्वसुकरं लोके कर्म कुर्याम संयुगे। इष्टॉल्लोकान् प्राप्तुमानो वयमद्य न संशयः॥
en: If, on the other hand, we can accomplish in battle that feat difficult of achieving, then, for certain, today we shall attain to the most desirable regions.

sa: यदि त्वेतन्मया कार्यं मृगेन्द्र यदि मन्यसे। समयं कृतमिच्छामि वर्तितव्यं यथा मयि॥
en: If, notwithstanding all this, you appoint me, O king of beasts, as your minister, I wish to make an agreement with you regarding your treatment towards men.

sa: याचतु भीमसेनं सभामध्ये दुपदस्यात्मजां च। युधिष्ठिरं त्वं परिसान्त्वयस्व राज्ये चैनं स्थापयस्वाभिपूज्य॥
